payload.name: aluminum
payload.rationale: Requested: melting point of Al at ambient pressure

_fulfilled_need.query: Find the melting point of aluminum at ambient pressure.

payload.task: melting_point of Al at ambient pressure (two-phase coexistence, ALCHEMI NPT + MACE-MPA-0, Cu validation)
payload.reason: Premise check passed: Tm of fcc Al at ~0 GPa is well defined and computable via solid-liquid two-phase coexistence (NPT, anisotropic, P=0), which avoids the superheating of single-phase heating. Planned validation: same setup on Cu vs ITS-90 fixed point 1357.77 K from /data/calibration/tier1.json. The run failed for lack of compute/agent budget. ALCHEMI NPT/NVT with MACE-MPA-0 (cuEq, float32, no compile) ran at about 1 s/step on the GB10 even for 2x640-atom boxes. The 8-system coexistence stage (Al 750-1050 K, Cu 1100-1550 K, 2000 steps) would have taken several hours, and the agent budget ran out first. Only solid NPT equilibration (Al a~4.13 A at ~900 K, solid stable) and part of the melt step finished. No coexistence data, no validation, so no melting point is reported. The experimental value (933.45 K, NIST-JANAF) was NOT reproduced by simulation and is not posted as a result.

details.next_steps: Rerun coex.py with more wall time. Profile neighbor-list/model overhead (try compile_model=True, larger skin). Use more atoms (>=2000) for finite-size control. Cu validation must land within about 50 K of 1357.77 K before the Al number is trusted.
